rec.name: Product Comparison Table (Compare Function)
rec.status: Reference only — ticket closed as duplicate of 'CRO | Global | Konkurrenzvergleich'; references kept in that ticket

what.text: A comparison section that places 2–3 selected products side by side. Each column shows the product image, name with variant, price and a 'View' button. Below them is a table of spec rows (e.g. Driver, Weight, Dimensions, Battery, Ear Pads, Voice Assistant). Unsupported features are marked with an X. In the Impact 'Sound' style, the table is capped at about 5 rows with a 'View all' toggle. In the Concept style, a left column carries an eyebrow ('Compare'), a headline ('Which wireless headphones are made for you?'), a short intro and a 'Learn more' button. The Impact style uses a centered headline, intro and 'Shop Headphones' button above the table.

why.text: Shoppers who are unsure which model fits often leave to compare elsewhere. Putting the comparison on-site cuts the effort of weighing options and lowers choice anxiety. Aligned spec rows make differences and price steps easy to see, which guides people to the right model, or to a higher-priced one when the extra value is visible. Marking missing features with an X makes the trade-offs obvious. The framing question ('Which … is made for you?') adds a light personalization cue.

how.text: Build a theme section with blocks, one block per product (product picker). Spec rows are either defined as row labels in the section with values read from product metafields, or entered manually per block. Render the product image, title (including variant), price and a 'View' button linking to the PDP. Show the first ~5 rows and hide the rest behind a 'View all' toggle (JS expand/collapse). Render an empty or false value as an X icon. Provide a heading area (eyebrow, headline, text, CTA button) with two layouts: left-aligned beside the table (Concept) or centered above it (Impact). Both reference themes already ship a version of this, so their code can be adapted.

items: CTA button label and link (e.g. 'Learn more' / 'Shop Headphones')
Heading layout: left column vs. centered above the table
Product blocks (2–3 products via product picker)
Spec rows: label plus value source (metafield or manual)
Number of rows visible before the 'View all' toggle
Icon or text for an unavailable feature (X)
Panel background color and corner radius

dependencies.text: Reference implementations: Shopify theme 'Concept' and the 'Sound' style of the 'Impact' theme. Likely needs product metafields (or per-block text fields) for specs, with consistent spec naming across the compared products. Needs at least two products with images and variants. No app required. Competitor comparison, as the duplicate ticket's title suggests, would need manually entered data rather than product-based data.

items: PDP views and add-to-cart rate from the comparison section
Conversion rate and AOV for sessions that saw or interacted with the section
Exit and bounce rate on the page hosting the section
Share of sales across compared models (mix shift to higher-priced option)

images.caption: Concept-theme layout: heading, intro and 'Learn more' CTA on the left; a grey panel on the right compares two headphones (image, name/variant, price, View button) over Driver, Weight, Dimensions and Battery rows.
Impact 'Sound' layout: centered headline, intro and 'Shop Headphones' button above a 3-product comparison with 5 spec rows, X marks for missing features, and a 'View all' toggle.
